markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (86%)** · Confident · Careful review
Conformal set holds Invasive only, but the second model and most neighbors disagree [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 86%, InSitu 13% | Clear lead |
| Conformal set | Invasive only | Single class at 90% |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.99 / 1.0 | No input flag |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Different top class |
| Similar cases | 2/5 Invasive | Mostly InSitu neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 4, 5, 10) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score; strongest association here [F2] · Validated
- **Scarce gland / tubule formation** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Few tubules; associated with invasive carcinoma [F3] · Validated
- **Few atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 2) · ↑ invasive · Low in-duct score; InSitu less supported · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 9) · ↑ invasive · Small contribution (+0.06) · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60). Faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0, so not shown to reflect the classifier. Normal lobules (0/20), mitoses (0/20) and necrosis (3/20) are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Simulated, resample-degraded frozen section: second model disagrees and 3 of 5 neighbors are InSitu.
- Reliability error AUROC is only 0.69 (CI 0.58–0.87); a clean quality score may miss errors.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 4, 5, 10** — confirm marked pleomorphism and invasive growth.
2. **Region 7** — lowest-risk region (63%); look for tubules or normal lobules.
3. **Region 2** — look for atypical cells confined within ducts, favoring InSitu.
